name: Analysis Worker Agent
description: A worker agent specialized in code analysis tasks. Performs static analysis, code review, and quality assessments.
author: commit-relay

capabilities.name: Code Analysis
capabilities.description: Analyze code for quality, complexity, and potential issues

capabilities.name: Code Review
capabilities.description: Review code changes and provide feedback

scaffold.script_template:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# {{agent_name}} - {{description}}
# Generated from analysis-worker template
#

set -euo pipefail

readonly SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
readonly PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../../.." && pwd)"

# Source libraries
source "$PROJECT_ROOT/scripts/lib/agentstudio/agent-register.sh"

# Agent configuration
readonly AGENT_NAME="{{agent_name}}"
readonly AGENT_CLASS="{{agent_class}}"

#
# Initialize worker
#
init_worker() {
    local capabilities='{{capabilities_json}}'
    
    AGENT_ID=$(register_agent \
        "$AGENT_CLASS" \
        "$AGENT_NAME" \
        "1.0.0" \
        "$capabilities" \
        "{{description}}")
    
    echo "Worker registered: $AGENT_ID"
}

#
# Analyze code
#
analyze_code() {
    local file_path="$1"
    
    echo "Analyzing: $file_path"
    
    # TODO: Implement code analysis logic
    # - Static analysis
    # - Complexity calculation
    # - Security scanning
    # - Style checking
    
    local analysis_result='{
        "file": "'"$file_path"'",
        "issues": [],
        "complexity": 0,
        "quality_score": 0
    }'
    
    echo "$analysis_result"
}

#
# Process task
#
process_task() {
    local task_file="$1"
    
    agent_heartbeat "$AGENT_ID"
    update_agent_status "$AGENT_ID" "busy"
    
    local start_time=$(date +%s)
    
    # Execute task
    local result=$(analyze_code "$task_file")
    local exit_code=$?
    
    local end_time=$(date +%s)
    local duration=$((end_time - start_time))
    
    # Update performance
    if [[ $exit_code -eq 0 ]]; then
        update_performance "$AGENT_ID" 1 0 $((duration * 1000)) 0
    else
        update_performance "$AGENT_ID" 0 1 $((duration * 1000)) 0
    fi
    
    update_agent_status "$AGENT_ID" "idle"
}

#
# Main worker loop
#
run_worker() {
    echo "Starting $AGENT_NAME..."
    
    init_worker
    update_agent_status "$AGENT_ID" "idle"
    
    # Wait for tasks
    while true; do
        agent_heartbeat "$AGENT_ID"
        
        # TODO: Check task queue
        # TODO: Process available tasks
        
        sleep {{poll_interval:-30}}
    done
}

# Run if executed directly
if [[ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" == "${0}" ]]; then
    run_worker
fi

parameters.name: poll_interval
parameters.description: Task queue polling interval in seconds

best_practices: Set appropriate file size limits to prevent resource exhaustion
Use incremental analysis for large codebases
Cache analysis results to avoid redundant work
Update performance metrics after each task
